ar03.name: Oval gold-tone studs with clear stone and braided frame
ar03.description: Oval stud earrings in a gold tone with a clear stone at the center and a braided-effect frame.
ar03.story: A gold-tone oval with a braided-effect frame surrounding a clear stone with a pearly look. Classic elegance with an artisanal-style detail that stands out.

ar04.name: Silver-tone hoops of linked hearts
ar04.description: Silver-tone hoops formed by small linked hearts.
ar04.story: A different kind of hoop: each link is a small silver-tone heart. Romantic without being saccharine, they are the sweet detail that goes with everything.

ar05.name: White enamel knot earrings with gold-tone edge
ar05.description: Stud earrings with a white enamel knot and a gold-tone edge.
ar05.story: The classic knot in white enamel with a gold-tone outline: minimalist, fresh and highly combinable. A modern basic that works day and night.

ar06.name: Gold-tone oval earrings with open horseshoe

ar07.name: Small engraved gold-tone hoops
ar07.description: Small hoops in a gold tone with an engraved surface.
ar07.story: Small, discreet and with an engraved texture that gives them character. The everyday hoops that never fail.

ar08.name: Thick gold-tone U-shaped hoops
ar08.description: Thick hoops in a gold tone with an elongated U shape and a smooth finish.

ar10.name: Organic-shape gold-tone earrings

ar15.description: Silver-tone stud earrings with a sparkling round stone at the center.
ar15.story: The classic stud with a sparkling stone: discreet by day, luminous by night. A silver-tone basic that cannot be missing from your jewelry box.

ar27.description: Round stud earrings in a gold tone with an engraved spiral.

ar29.name: Gold-tone marbled drop earrings
ar29.description: Stud earrings shaped like a gold-tone drop with a white marbled interior.
ar29.story: A gold-tone drop whose white, marble-effect interior adds contrast and originality. Delicate with an artistic touch that makes them unique.

ar32.story: Five elongated petals with a horizontal line texture form this modern-feeling gold-tone flower. A different floral design with plenty of presence.

ar34.description: Silver-tone hoop with a bow detail.
ar34.story: A silver-tone hoop topped with a small bow: the flirty detail that turns a basic into a piece with charm. Sweet and current.

ar36.story: Gold-tone hexagons with a bamboo-style segmented texture: a hoop with geometry and a tropical character. Modern, distinctive and highly combinable.

ar39.name: Gold-tone shell earrings with pearls
